hypothesis: An available licensed learned relation model can improve reading order on exactly the same detected boxes, without regenerating content or changing detection.
model: Official PaddlePaddle PP-DocLayoutV2_safetensors revision880e8971b88938518611c54fc0f59ad57849c9d4, Apache-2.0; instantiate only20,743,304parameter ReadingOrder subnetwork from already installed official PaddleX code. No full detector or VLM.
inputs: All8pages of stroke-object-batch-v1 with original PP-DocLayout-S boxes score>=.5, unchanged. Six new source pages for the geometric pipeline; they are a fixed comparative set here, not known-unseen data relative to upstream pretraining.
mapping: Official class_order table. PP-S formula maps to display class15; text22; header12/footer8; header_image13/footer_image9; chart_title/table_title map unified caption7. Unknown classes fail page; no silent exclusion.
inference: Original normalized0..1000 xyxy coordinates, official weight transpose rules, exact parameter-name/shape match, official vote decoder. One ordinary inference and one preregistered reversed-input stability check each page. No tuning/training.
metrics: Proposal-order quality against source-only reference, candidate coverage, source-reading pair conflicts, latency/RSS, input-order stability. Cannot fix missed candidates or falsely merged regions; formula ownership remains separate.
stop: One frozen comparison. Any loader mismatch or memory limit is a failed qualification, not an excuse to raise limits. No fallback to a paid or generative model.
